# nodus-sdk

> Unified SDK for the Nodus ecosystem — single install, all bridges wired automatically.
> Part of the [Masterplan Infinite Weave](https://www.the-master-plan.com/) ecosystem.
> Created by Shawn Knight.

nodus-sdk auto-wires the 27-package Nodus ecosystem. Instead of manually installing and
configuring nodus-lang + nodus-http + nodus-observability + nodus-sql + ..., a single
`pip install nodus-sdk[agent,sql,fastapi]` installs and wires everything.

## Status

v0.1.0 — prepared, not yet published. 99 tests passing.

## Install

```
pip install nodus-sdk                    # core + nodus-lang
pip install nodus-sdk[agent]             # + agent coordination
pip install nodus-sdk[sql]               # + SQL persistence
pip install nodus-sdk[fastapi]           # + FastAPI bridge
pip install nodus-sdk[agent,sql,fastapi] # everything
```

## Usage

```python
from nodus_sdk import create_runtime

rt = create_runtime(
    http=True,
    llm=True,
    sql="sqlite:///db.sqlite3",
)
result = rt.run_source(source)
```

## Key Exports

- `NodusSDKRuntime` — extended NodusRuntime with all bridges auto-wired
- `create_runtime(**kwargs)` — factory that selects and wires bridges based on kwargs
- `detect_available()` — returns which optional packages are installed
- 9 bridges: redis, http, llm, observability, sql, vector, scheduler, webhook, api

## Important Note

Bridge host functions return **maps** (dicts), not Records. Nodus scripts must use
`r["key"]` not `r.key` when accessing bridge results.
